<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Reinforcements''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍増援部隊</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手の場のカードのキャラクターと宇宙船の数の合計が、自分のよりも多いとき、１フォース消費して運命数を引く。その数の分の「ストームトルーパー」または「タイ・ファイター」をロストデッキから取り戻して再使用できる。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍のストームトルーパーは、１個分隊８～１０名で構成されている。作戦行動を取る場合は、増援部隊から人員を補充するのが、通常の手順である。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial reinforcement unit.

'''Card text:''' When the opponent has more characters and starships in play in total than you do, use 1 Force and draw destiny. You may retrieve that number of Stormtroopers or TIE fighters from the Lost Deck for reuse.

'''Lore:''' Imperial stormtrooper squads consist of eight to ten soldiers. During operations, the usual procedure is to replenish personnel from reinforcement units.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese connects Stormtroopers and TIE fighters with “or”; the English says “and/or.” The Japanese lore describes replenishing personnel from reinforcement units, while the English says reinforcements are typically held in reserve.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Reinforcements]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=217s Star Wars CCG Japanese Premiere Complete Set], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 3:37.</ref>
